# blendops-help

Purpose: Route users to the right BlendOps skill, document, or next safe action without overclaiming runtime, artifact, or package readiness.

Help an agent or user decide the single safest next action in BlendOps when the goal is unclear, current status is unknown, or an entry point into skills, docs, runtime readiness, packaging, or release review is needed.

Metadata: Category `routing-and-governance` | Role `ambiguous-intent-entry-router` | Tier `L0` | Routing: `entry-and-stage-routing#1` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- the user asks “what should I do next?” and the goal or current state is unclear
- the user is unsure how to enter the BlendOps skill catalog or documentation
- runtime, artifact, packaging, or release status is unknown and needs initial triage
- no workflow artifacts exist yet and the user needs a safe starting skill or doc
- an agent needs a concise entry-point recommendation before starting work
- Trigger phrases: "What should I do next?", "Which BlendOps skill should I use?", "Is this ready?", "Can I run the runtime eval?", "How do I package/install BlendOps?", "What is blocked?"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- The goal is clear, preflight is passed, and stage or artifact inventory already exists → use `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`; Selects the single immediate next skill from a locked precedence order and exits to pre-handoff-verification on any failed gate)
- The goal is clear and the user wants to select the right recipe or pack → use `recipe-fit-assessor` (`references/skill-recipe-fit-assessor.md`; Scores candidate recipes/packs and detects multi-deliverable scope)
- A recipe or pack is already selected and needs preflight readiness verification → use `pack-prerequisite-checker` (`references/skill-pack-prerequisite-checker.md`; Evaluates the preflight matrix across brief completeness, runtime posture, and asset readiness)
- The user explicitly asks to turn an idea into a structured 3D brief → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; Locks the canonical 8-slot 3D brief before scene planning)
- The user asks to plan a product-hero scene directly → use `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Handles domain-specific scene planning once brief and recipe are known)
- The user asks for render or export artifact verification → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; Classifies artifact truth states from on-disk paths and validation notes)
- The user asks for Blender MCP runtime preflight verification → use `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`; Verifies Path 1 or Path 2 runtime readiness without claiming execution)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `user_request` (`string`): Ambiguous, mixed, or entry-level user question about BlendOps capabilities or next action
- Optional input `current_status_context` (`object`): Optional context about known files, docs, or blockers
- Output contract: `recommended_next_action`, `target_skill_or_doc`, `why_this_is_safe` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Ask for the current goal and status if missing.
2. If the goal is already clear and artifacts exist, hand off immediately to `workflow-stage-router`.
3. Otherwise, identify whether the entry need is brief/planning setup, runtime readiness, evidence verification, install/package docs, or release review.
4. Route to the single smallest safe skill or doc.
5. Preserve Draft v0, runtime, and artifact truth (downgrade-only, never upgrade).

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [progression] Recipe or pack selection when goal becomes clear → `recipe-fit-assessor` (`references/skill-recipe-fit-assessor.md`)
- [conditional] Pack preflight readiness check when recipe is already chosen → `pack-prerequisite-checker` (`references/skill-pack-prerequisite-checker.md`)
- [conditional] In-flight workflow routing (clear goal + existing artifacts) → `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`)
- [progression] Initial 3D brief creation → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`)
- [conditional] Runtime path selection → `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`)
- [conditional] Official runtime setup → `official-runtime-setup-guide` (`references/skill-official-runtime-setup-guide.md`)
- [conditional] Runtime readiness preflight → `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`)
- [fallback] MCP bridge port/session conflict → `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skill-runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`)
- [alternative] Scene planning → `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`)
- [conditional] Render/export evidence → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`)
- [fallback] Failed workflow gate / pre-handoff check → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`)
- [conditional] GLB handoff → `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-glb-web-handoff.md`)
- [progression] Final response → `non-blender-user-response-writer` (`references/skill-non-blender-user-response-writer.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Before runtime work, point to `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md`, `runtime-path-picker`, and `official-runtime-readiness-checker`.
- Replace or duplicate `workflow-stage-router` precedence logic once the goal is clear and artifacts exist.
- Install Blender or runtimes.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Create or mutate scene data.
- Render/export artifacts.
- Publish packages or marketplace listings.
